📈 What moved today, Friday 27 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 rose 2.3% to close above 100,000, at 100,815. Resource shares jumped another 5%, industrials rose 1.2%, and banks and insurers gained 0.6%.

💱 The rand firmed to about R17.39 to the dollar, and Brent oil fell 1.4% to about $95.20.

What it means for you: a firmer rand and cheaper oil today both help the December petrol price, and a two-day rally lifts retirement and unit-trust balances.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
